title: Betrayers of Kamigawa: card flavor text

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane torn by the Kami War.

entities.name: The Kami War
entities.description: War in which kami turned on mortals.

entities.name: General Takeno
entities.description: Human general who fights the kami.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: Ruler of the empire who grows suspicious and seeks a spirit-child.

entities.name: Sensei Hisoka
entities.description: Minamo sensei who questions the war.

entities.name: Sensei Golden-Tail
entities.description: Sensei quoted on the heart and on curses.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: Monk master of Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Snow-Fur
entities.description: A kitsune poet.

entities.name: Tender-Hand
entities.description: A kitsune healer.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Nezumi lord who fears the Okiba Gang.

entities.name: Masako the Humorless
entities.description: Konda's servant who knows his deepest secrets.

entities.name: Kiku, Night's Flower
entities.description: Assassin of Takenuma.

entities.name: Nighteyes
entities.description: A nezumi necromancer.

entities.name: Isao, Enlightened Bushi
entities.description: A bushi who claims no allegiance in the war; Konda orders Takeno to find him.

entities.name: Ku-Ku
entities.description: An akki poet.

entities.name: Kenzo the Hardhearted
entities.description: A warrior who died and woke back on the battlefield.

entities.name: Noboru
entities.description: A master kitemaker.

entities.name: Dokai, Weaver of Life
entities.description: Speaker who mocks the soratami on Jukai.

entities.name: Sakiko, Mother of Summer
entities.description: Speaker on how the kami keep energy of growing things.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Held over a dozen oni in blood oath.

entities.name: Ishi-Ishi
entities.description: Akki king of the Flaming Pebbles, fallen.

entities.name: Yukora
entities.description: A demon imprisoned by ninety-nine monks and freed on their deaths.

entities.name: Kyoki
entities.description: Oni called Eater of Minds and Lord of Fear.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The greatest kami.

entities.name: Oyobi, Who Split the Heavens
entities.description: Kami whose angry call split the sky, from which her champions descended.

entities.name: Takenuma Swamp
entities.description: Swamp whose wizards face human horrors daily.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: Human city now ruins among rotting bamboo, plagued by oni.

entities.name: Shinka
entities.description: Bloodstained ogre keep.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: Forest of the monks.

entities.name: Mita
entities.description: A village whose inhabitants relived their tragedies.

entities.name: The Battle of Silk
entities.description: Six-year battle begun when kumo attacked the monks' shrine.

entities.name: Okiba Gang
entities.description: Nezumi thieves and assassins.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits at war with mortals.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Demons summoned and freed by ogres.

events.summary: Takeno exhorts soldiers to rise like the sun and die as heroes.
events.quote: Rise like the sun, stand like the mountain, charge like the lion, die as a hero.

events.summary: Warriors turn to face O-Kagachi and die of awe.
events.quote: The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath.

events.summary: Oyobi splits the sky and her champions descend.
events.quote: Her angry call split the sky. From that rift descended her champions.

events.summary: Konda grows suspicious that unseen hands manipulate his allies.
events.quote: Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands.

events.summary: Konda falls ill with fever and sees a spirit-child offering a way to make his empire last forever.
events.quote: Early in his reign, Konda fell ill.

events.summary: Konda orders Takeno to find Isao, who claims no allegiance.
Konda sends warriors to parley with the ogre-magi; their fate is unknown.
events.quote: In desperation, Konda sent warriors to parley with the ogre-magi.

events.summary: Hisoka asks Konda whether their graves will say they were crushed by their own arrogance.
events.quote: What will it say on our graves, Lord Konda?

events.summary: Kami pass over Mita and make villagers relive their tragedies, sapping their will to fight.
events.quote: As the kami passed over the village of Mita, the inhabitants relived their three most grievous tragedies.

events.summary: Kumo attack the monks' shrine and the Battle of Silk begins.
events.quote: On the fifty-seventh day of the Battle of Silk, the bell again tolled in hopes of summoning mortal aid.

events.summary: Yukora is freed when the ninety-nine monks who trapped him die, and seeks vengeance.
events.quote: Upon the death of the ninety-nine, the spell was broken, and the demon returned to the mortal world seeking vengeance for its imprisonment.

events.summary: Oni demand ever more sacrifices from the ogres who freed them.
events.quote: Once freed, the oni demanded more and more sacrifices to appease them.

events.summary: Numai is reduced to ruins plagued by oni.
events.quote: only the ruins of Numai remain, deep amid rotting bamboo and plagued by oni.

events.summary: Takada faces the kami alone as last of the rearguard.
events.quote: Takada, last of the rearguard, faced the kami alone.

events.summary: Marrow-Gnawer orders the guard tripled against the Okiba Gang.
Hidetsugu holds over a dozen oni in blood oath.
events.quote: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath.

events.summary: Kenzo wakes back on the battlefield after dying.
events.quote: But then I woke up back on the battlefield.

events.summary: Takeno chides the imperial mapmaker for arriving too late again.
events.quote: We arrived at the battlefield too late.

events.summary: Masako condemns a god held prisoner in human hands.
events.quote: This god held prisoner in human hands has put all humanity in the hands of angry gods.

relations.quote: Masako was privy to a great many of Konda's deepest secrets
Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

relations.quote: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath.
The war sent Kamigawa into turmoil.
